headline: Cadillac's Charlotte engine factory opens on 18 December
body: General Motors president Mark Reuss said the factory in Charlotte, North Carolina opens on 18 December. General Motors was approved as a power unit supplier from 2029. Cadillac is the only team yet to score in 2026 and has qualified slowest at the last four rounds.

headline: FIA approves F1 staff separation rules for 2027
body: The World Motor Sport Council approved five new articles in the 2027 operational regulations that keep non-F1 staff away from F1 projects. Non-F1 staff will be barred from the F1 factory, and simulators, wind tunnels and data centres face restrictions. Staff moving between F1 and other programmes need a new contract, and anyone leaving a team must wait at least a year to return.

headline: Adobe becomes Alpine's official AI fan experience partner
body: Adobe joins Alpine in its first Formula 1 commercial partnership, built around AI design tools for fans. Major activations begin at the start of the 2027 season, with more details due in Austin on Thursday evening.
